headline: Onward Technologies: Promoter Acquires 30,127 Equity Shares from Open Market
sum: Mrs Prachi Mehta, a promoter of Onward Technologies Limited, acquired 30,127 equity shares from the open market, disclosed to NSE via intimate exchange filing on 18 August 2026.
implication: Promoter open-market purchases trigger continuous disclosure and shareholding pattern reporting obligations under SEBI PIT regulations; monitor for insider trading compliance window and subsequent substantial acquisition disclosures.
detail: Onward Technologies Limited, a Mumbai-based technology services firm, disclosed an open-market acquisition by promoter Mrs Prachi Mehta of 30,127 equity shares. The transaction was notified to NSE under the intimation framework for promoter share acquisitions. No purchase consideration amount was disclosed in the exchange filing. The acquisition represents a consolidation of promoter stake and requires disclosure of updated shareholding patterns within the specified window.
